Sim execution: ran tick() — RT-002 (2 stops) + RT-003 (1 stop) both flipped dispatched → in_progress → completed with stops marked delivered in seq order, vehicles returned idle, delivery_completed events fired with meta.route_id + seq; ensure_fleet correctly excludes route-mounted shipments (db aggregation found 0 shipments with duplicate vehicles). Frontend: full Lagos-area happy path — selected DSP-2026-062 pending shipment (chip added, origin auto-locked to 'Flour Mills Lagos Warehouse'), opened adhoc-dialog (30 destinations, 6 products), added ad-hoc 10-unit stop to Prime Distribution Services Ltd, clicked builder-preview-btn → builder-itinerary rendered 2 numbered stops (12.5km/28min + 11.7km/26min), builder-totals showed '24.2 km · 0h 54m drive · 844 units · Google roads · optimized', polyline + numbered markers visible on RouteBuilderMap, dispatched → RT-004 created, success state, builder reset, active-routes-table grew to 4 rows, route-timeline-btn opened route-execution-sheet with all 5 sub-blocks (exec-status-badge=DISPATCHED, exec-summary 24.2km/0h54m/844, exec-progress 0%, exec-itinerary w/ origin 'departed' + 2 exec-stop-row showing 'En route — next stop' for seq 1 and 'Pending' for seq 2, exec-events trail with route_planned + vehicle_dispatched + 2x shipment_loaded + shipment_created), Esc closes sheet cleanly, regression check tab-control-tower still renders tower-kpi-strip. No functional console errors — only 2 Radix a11y warnings about missing DialogTitle on adhoc-dialog (cosmetic, non-blocking).

issues: Radix DialogContent renders without a DialogTitle, triggering an a11y console warning twice when opening the dialog. Wrap the heading in DialogTitle (or use Radix VisuallyHidden) for screen-reader users. Non-blocking.

action_items: Add a <DialogTitle> (or VisuallyHidden one) inside AdHocStopDialog to silence the Radix a11y console warning.
critical_code_review_comments: routes/route_planning.py:178 — last leg uses route['legs'][pos] but when optimize=true Google may return order that does not equal range(len(stops)); legs[] indexing assumes order index aligns with leg position. Spot-check: optimized==true with len>1 actually works (sim+preview produced sane cum totals), so the assumption holds for this implementation, but a comment explaining the legs[] vs order[] alignment would help future maintainers.
routes/route_planning.py:240 — assigned set built via db.vehicles.distinct + per-route find iterates every route vehicle on each board call; consider a single aggregation pipeline.

routes/route_planning.py:387 — counters.find_one_and_update with upsert+return_document=True will return the post-increment doc, so seq starts at 1; works but {return_document: True} is implicit ReturnDocument.AFTER — explicit import would be clearer.

routes/route_planning.py:495 — events query unions meta.route_id with shipment_id, which can pull pre-route shipment_created events from other contexts if the same shipment was reused; not an issue today (ad-hoc shipments are brand new + ids unique) but worth noting.
Frontend AdHocStopDialog missing DialogTitle — see design issue above; add VisuallyHidden DialogTitle to comply with Radix a11y contract.
